headline: Asian Markets Slide Following Wall Street Losses and Middle East Tensions
summary: Asian stock markets traded lower, tracking Wall Street's negative close, while elevated crude oil prices and ongoing West Asia tensions weighed on investor sentiment.
why: Global equity markets are highly interconnected, with regional exchanges frequently reacting to overnight developments in US markets and international commodity shocks.

impacts.name: Asian Equities
impacts.why: Negative global sentiment and rising oil prices increase risk aversion among regional investors.

why_moved: Spillovers from Wall Street declines combined with geopolitical anxiety and rising energy costs prompted broad-based equity selling across Asian exchanges.
